notes.title: Fixed occluder issues in Zenith and Core, more controllers recognized at once.
notes.content:
Fixed visual bugs and a quality of life issue:


 There was a room in the Zenith where the walls would turn transparent when viewed from a certain angle and three doors in the Core where the next room was invisible until crossing the threshold, those issues have been fixed.
 Players with multiple controllers connected should now be able to use any of the first 8 they have without having to disconnect it and reconnecting it in the first port.

notes.title: Project Hive is now free on Steam, the other game from the class of 2019-2020!
notes.content:
Campus ADN and the class of 2019-2020 are proud to announce the release of our other game for the year, Project Hive: A sci-fi 3D shooter where you battle aggressive monsters as you escape a damaged mining outpost on an alien world!


Play as Alexei, an isolated survivor of a catastrophic event on a remote outpost.
Shoot four different kinds of alien life forms to survive their relentless attacks!
Choose from different shooting modes to fit your style.
Avoid the dangers of the damaged outpost.
Get in lucky shots with rare accelerated burts of gunfire!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454100/Project_Hive/

notes.title: Can no longer target objects behind the camera.
notes.content:
A bug where it was possible to hook on to objects behind the camera has been fixed. 
 The first prompt suggesting that the player look at the progession screen now occurs right after Dewey asks for help rather than after a set amount of time since the level loaded.
 During the expository cinematic when entering the Nexus for the first time, Dewey now specifically says to go the Archives of the Dream Wing to start the mission, rather than simply to go to the Dream Wing.

notes.title: New error sounds and a louder error sound.
notes.content:
Negative feedback sounds have been added and another has been made louder:

 Bringing the wrong book to a small bookcase now makes an error sound.
 If you find yourself in a situation where the Agent is falling for too long and she is teleported to a safe space there is now also an error sound.
 The error sound for attempting to move a stack of two cubes on rails without the required strength is now louder.

notes.title: First update of 2021
notes.content:
In this update controller bugs were solved, anchor points were added and missing music was restored.

Game now goes on pause when a controller is disconnected.
Game can be played even if no controller was connected when it was launched.
Some puzzles that could be broken by movable cube placements have had anchor points added.
A bug where music was missing when going back to the main menu and changing the language has been fixed.
 New tutorial pannel for basic controls.
